text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time has passed since
my first three years with Victoire Pisa ended.

text_block_list.name: The Four
text_block_list.text: Taaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Victoire Pisa attended a training camp
alongside her generation-mates at a facility
arranged by Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: "*pant, pant*! ...Phew!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Rose, your racecraft has gotten
even better. You had me chasing you the entire way.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No, you're the one whose instincts have sharpened.
Your timing on making your moves today was flawless.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Ruler's tactical maneuvering has improved even further.
Pisa's acceleration on the final straight
was noticeably more consistent as well.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
However...
We both still have challenges to overcome.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Naturally. Hence, trial and error.
Now, on to the next round!

text_block_list.name: The Four
text_block_list.text: Thanks for the food.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
*munch*... Hmph!
Hunger really is the best spice.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I ran my heart out today.
I'm totally exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"The owner said everyone should feel free to take seconds.
Apparently, they won't be able to handle all the leftovers otherwise."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ah...... Today is the final day, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash's casual remark
brings about a momentary silence.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —What are everyone's plans from here on?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Once my active racing career is over,
I plan to help manage this place for a while,
alongside training the next generation.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Whoa...! You?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
"I wanted to spend my days involved in racing
from a different perspective than before, you see."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
For the peace and prosperity of my family, the things I must learn
are still... still overwhelmingly vast.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Where's Ruler?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I have an overseas campaign in my sights.
Next time, I'm aiming straight for the top."

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Once that's over and I bring my own racing career to an end...
there's an Umamusume I want to look after."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"You want to look out for someone...
Are you talking about Kiseki-san?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Who knows? And what about you?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I have no intention of settling down just yet. I plan on challenging myself for as long as I can.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: If I dare to speak of what lies beyond—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I intended to return to Germany after the Twinkle Series,
but I might change my plans.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Ho...? Now that is intriguing.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Going through the Twinkle Series made me feel
that getting involved in nurturing the next generation
in Japan could be quite fascinating as well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I don't have a concrete plan yet...
—What about you, Pisa?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: As for me... let's see.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
That massive, spinning circle
at the Arima Kinen...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I want to remain in that circle for as long as possible.
I wish to dedicate my efforts so that circle continues forever."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
As long as I can race, I'll do it through racing.
And after that...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"I was thinking of traveling the world.
Perhaps to... Turkey, for instance."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: I see, Turkey, is it? I often hear of Japanese Umamusume being involved in training the next generation there.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Yes, indeed. What's more,
racing is a very popular sport in Turkey as well.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's not quite on the scale of Japan.
That is precisely why I want to go there in person,
expand the circle... and connect them.”

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, that's surely a story for the distant future.
For now, I still want to keep running on these legs."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: With you, and with everyone.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
We are not bound by a shared destiny.
However, we are rivals who lived in the very same era.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: A bosom friend.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Would calling us 'Die Geschwister'—be an exaggeration?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, it's my treasure.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Someday, the time will come when our paths part.
We each have our own ideals and dreams to fulfill.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Even if distance or time should keep us apart,
there is nothing... nothing to fear.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Because we are already so strongly connected.
